name: Island State of Mind
why: Never chartered/private cruising history; twin Volvo D2-55F with April 2026 engine+saildrive service, huge 53 GPH engine-driven watermaker, full refrigeration, dishwasher + washing machine, dual 16k BTU A/C, Garmin radar, Simrad autopilot and a second hydraulic autopilot ram as backup.
risks: Off-grid electrical is weak for our target: 760Ah AGM, only 600W solar + 400W wind, standard alternators and no built-in generator disclosed. Standing-rig age is not stated. Four-cabin layout and tax not paid/excluded.
next_step: Get standing-rig/sail dates and survey, casualty/core history and electrical diagram; quote lithium + 1.8–2.4kW solar + inverter/high-output charging. Only pursue aggressively if seller has further flexibility after the $31k cut.
notes: NEW 9/3 FIND + PRICE CUT. Excellent private-cruising history and liveaboard amenities, but current ask plus electrical modernization makes it a secondary value candidate rather than a top bargain.

name: Squid Attack
why: Exceptional age/size/price anomaly: 2021 final-generation 450F owner’s version, second-to-last hull, about 1,663/1,646h Yanmars, custom hardtop, full A/C and 37 GPH Rainman watermaker in ideal BVI geography. TMM managed it since new and supplied the full maintenance record. Factory Lagoon bulkhead modification was augmented with additional local reinforcement.
risks: Standing rigging is original; house bank is 4× Full River AGM from Nov. 2021; only a 2.5kW inverter and no solar disclosed; genset is a very high 8,809h. Tax is not paid. Positives: saildrives are serviced every 250h/annually, 2024 Doyle main is newer, and broker reports no significant structural casualty/claim history beyond a stolen-dinghy claim.
refit_display: $50–80k incl. rig + lithium/solar modernization, plus genset reserve
all_in_display: ~$449–479k before tax/duty + survey/closing, with additional generator contingency prudent
stage: Full TMM maintenance file received — decision gate
next_step: YOUR DECISION: whether the 2021 platform at $399k is strong enough to justify survey/offer diligence despite original rig, AGM/no-solar electrical and 8,809h genset. No offer, call or travel discussion initiated.
notes: TMM says charter is finished and the boat is available immediately. Seller just cut the price substantially and Rory expects little additional flexibility. Maintenance transparency is excellent; the remaining question is whether the unavoidable rig/electrical/genset economics still beat older turnkey alternatives.

name: Katla
why: One-owner liveaboard build with extraordinary 2024 upgrades: carbon mast, furling boom, complete standing rig and new main; 3.3kW solar; 2023–24 lithium/Victron architecture including 10kW inverter; only about 372/369h on D2-55s; full A/C, washer, Starlink and 60 L/h watermaker serviced in 2025.
risks: At top of budget and tax not paid; four-cabin layout; original genoa; only one autopilot; generator model/hours not disclosed. 2023 rudder stocks/steering reinforcement needs explanation, and chainplates/mast step/bulkhead/casualty history need documentation. Multi-voltage battery architecture needs a diagram.
all_in_display: ~$455–475k before tax plus survey/closing; higher if hidden structural/generator work appears
contact: David Walters Yacht Sales / Katla listing
next_step: Wait for survey/refit invoices, generator data, electrical diagram, saildrive history and explanation of rudder/2024 rig work. Price only works if expensive hard parts are genuinely done and seller has some flexibility.
notes: NEW 9/3 TOP-TIER FIND. The 2024 carbon rig plus 3.3kW solar/lithium/10kW inverter combination is unusually aligned with the desired spec. Outreach sent.

name: Stress Less
why: Very strong low-entry owner-version platform: 2017 Volvo D2-40 engines with only about 510h, 600Ah lithium house bank, new inverter in 2024, fixed solar/MPPT, watermaker, Northern Lights 9kW genset, Cruisair A/C, rigid bimini and Highfield/15hp tender.
risks: Sparse new listing: engine replacement reason, generator hours, exact solar/battery age, rig/sail ages, saildrive history, survey/moisture/casualty history and core/structural condition are not yet disclosed. 2012 base hull still requires age-related diligence.
all_in_display: ~$320–345k plus survey/closing; potentially about $370k if full rig/sails are due
contact_channel: Listing contact form / phone only; no verified public email surfaced
next_step: High-priority diligence candidate. Obtain survey, engine-replacement and saildrive records, genset hours, exact solar/lithium details, rig/sails and damage/moisture history. No verified public email surfaced in this pass, so no outreach was sent.
notes: NEW 9/3 VALUE FIND. At $299.9k, the 2017 low-hour engines plus existing lithium/solar/genset/A-C/watermaker leave substantial budget for rig or modernization if the survey is clean.

name: Palermo Lagoon 450F
why: Unusually young 2020 450F around €340k with twin 57hp Yanmars, 11kW generator, 48,000-BTU A/C, Schenker 50 L/h watermaker, AIS/autopilot and 2kVA inverter. Category A/unrestricted and a large headline age discount.
risks: Four-cabin configuration and likely commercial/charter use; no solar disclosed and only three unspecified batteries. Engine hours conflict within listing (3,369 vs 3,669). Standing rig/sails, Lagoon bulkhead/compression-post status, saildrive history, generator hours and casualty/moisture history unknown. Tax not paid plus 5% buyer commission.
all_in_display: ~€395–430k incl. 5% commission + refit, before tax/survey; €440k+ if rig or major machinery is due
next_step: Wait for charter/maintenance file, structural docs, rig/sails, exact hours, saildrives, genset, battery/solar and VAT/title details. Current headline price is compelling only if phase-out condition is clean.
notes: NEW 9/3 FIND. 2020 age at €340k is rare, but 5% buyer commission + tax-not-paid status + electrical modernization can erase much of the headline discount. Outreach sent.

name: Vikama
why: Extensive late-2025 liveaboard refit: ~4.2kW bifacial solar with rainwater-collection/shade structure, 2024 Elvstrøm main + genoa, Schenker 50 L/h watermaker, washing machine, B&G Halo radar/AIS, Starlink/InReach, 3kW + 1.5kW inverters, new freezer/cooler, dinghy/outboard and full engine/saildrive service.
risks: Former charter/private-use history and 4-cabin layout; engine hours not published. Standing rigging was only reported inspected in 2025—not replaced. Battery spec is internally contradictory (7×140Ah new house batteries vs 'lithium batteries to be installed'); only a portable Honda generator is listed and permanent A/C is unclear. Lagoon bulkhead/compression-post status and casualty/moisture history are unknown.
next_step: Wait for current engine hours/service details, standing-rig report/replacement age, Lagoon structural docs, actual battery chemistry, A/C/generator reality, survey/casualty history and seller flexibility. Do not discuss travel until the hard facts support it.
notes: NEW 9/3 FIND + PRICE CUT. Horizon's own page still shows $465k while fresher TMC/YachtWorld/Boat Trader pages show $439k. 4.2kW solar is exceptional; the battery/generator/rig ambiguities determine whether this is truly turnkey or a $50k+ conversion.

name: Monseas
model: Fountaine Pajot Helia 44 Maestro Owner’s Version
why: Near-turnkey owner-version package: 2019 Volvo D2-40F engines + 130S saildrives, 2023 Blue Wave standing rigging + genoa, 900Ah Relion lithium, 1.44kW solar, Victron MultiPlus II 3kW/Cerbo, Onan 7.5kW ~1,994h, 33 GPH CruiseRO watermaker, three 16k BTU A/C units, washer/dryer, 2025 high-output alternator, radar/AIS and extensive cruising gear.
risks: Headline ask is $9k above the core $450k ceiling and 2021 lithium is now ~5 years old. Main-sail replacement date is unclear; generator/saildrive service history and battery health need proof. Listing claims no damage history but no recent survey is advertised; moisture/core, chainplates/mast step and casualty history must still be independently verified.
all_in_display: ~$465–480k + survey/closing before negotiation; attractive if seller moves into low/mid-$400s
contact: David Walters Yachts / Catamaran Brokerage MLS
next_step: Wait for survey/records, generator + saildrive service, mainsail date, lithium health, real A/C-from-inverter capability, moisture/structural history and seller's real floor. No travel discussion until price/documentation make sense.
notes: NEW 9/3 EXCEPTION ABOVE TARGET. Unlike most $400k-plus boats, nearly every expensive cruising system is already present or recently renewed. It becomes a serious bargain only if seller flexibility pulls the acquisition price closer to the core budget.
